body:
**Kind:** goal

Source: `docs/designs/governed-factory.md` (milestone m1).

## Job

When agents still run only attended, I want a thin end-to-end slice from issue to contained run to PR with receipts, so I can let agents work unattended from the M1 exit.

## Outcome

- The containment port and the `sbx` provider exist; the conformance suite passes on `sbx` and fails on the deliberately weak adapter (M1-1, M1-2, M1-3).
- The launcher's `runUnit` and the `launch` verb run one issue in `sbx`, check the declared scope, push under the builder App and write a receipt with the substrate fields (M1-4, M1-5, M1-12).
- Headless provider invocations and App token minting work (M1-6, M1-7).
- The coordinator's `tick` and `resume`, the control-repository reader, the pause flag, check-ins and the dead-man rule work; the gate sweeper has a product caller; the poller claims with deterministic IDs and a conditional append and admits only under an agreed admission gate (M1-8, M1-9, M1-10).
- The trust-policy loader exists and `satisfyGate` accepts a human gate only with a verified signed act where the posture requires it (M1-13).
- The demo runs from an issue to an execution receipt; the watchdog writes alerts (M1-14).
- The week-0 gate re-run passes with the launcher, and `guarded-run.mjs` is then deleted (M1-14).
- ADR 027 (OpenRig capability review) and ADR 026 (intake seam) are written (M1-15, M1-16).

## Release intent

No publication. From the exit, agents run unattended through the launcher and the author merges every PR.

## Split judgment

Each work item in this milestone of the design is one focused PR with a declared scope; items that require each other stay one PR. The milestone's re-verification item (where it has one) lands first and fixes the exact file list. Shipping order follows the design's table.
